observations.behavior: Adds documentation for the new dashboard, including Acquisition and Engagement sections, shared date and comparison filters, and the behavior of the Ad performance tab.
observations.code_quote: Acquisition and Engagement reuse the Web Analytics stats table with a shared traffic breakdown selector. The Acquisition table shows visitors and pageviews; the Engagement table shows visitors and bounce rate. Summary cards remain visitors, sessions, and pageviews for Acquisition, and session duration and bounce rate for Engagement. Changing sections preserves the selected breakdown, date range, and comparison.
